name: Triceps kickback
summary: Hinged forward with the upper arm held level, straighten the elbow behind you, then bend.
setup: Hinge forward with one hand on a bench, working arm nearest the phone, upper arm level with the back and elbow bent. Straighten the arm fully behind you, squeeze, then bend back to 90°.
brief: Hinge forward with one hand on a bench, the working upper arm level with the back and the elbow bent. Straighten the arm fully behind you, squeeze, then bend back to 90 degrees.
why: From the side the elbow angle opens to straight each rep, so reps are counted.
tempo: Out 1 s, squeeze 1 s, back 2 s.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Upper arm dropping
faults.tip: The elbow stays high by the ribs; if it drops, the weight is too heavy.

faults.label: Upper arm dropping
faults.tip: The upper arm stays parallel to the floor; only the forearm moves.

faults.label: Snapping the elbow straight
faults.tip: Locking hard at the end is where the elbow gets sore.

points.t: Straightens fully; upper arm stays level.
